President Trump can be upset that ABC and NBC didn't broadcast his speech, but threatening to revoke their licenses for it is an attack on press freedom and a dangerous precedent, explains Cato’s @dr_inserra.

The government does not and should not have the power to censor or compel media organizations in their reporting or programming.
